messages:
toni: Hey everyone  excited to join as Senior Product Designer today! Quick onboarding checklist Qs: I don't have Figma org access, Notion /Product is 403, and I can't find the UX research consent template or where we log participant payments. Who's best to ping for each?

maya: welcome @toni :tada: I'm design-ops. Figma invites are SSO; check spam and the 'Other' tab. If you still see `Request access` DM me your exact work email and I'll trigger a manual add. Notion 403 usually means SSO group sync  I'll open an IT ticket.

felix: hi @toni  research-ops here. Consent templates and screeners live in Drive > UX > Templates (consent_standard_v3). Participant payments use the Research Payment form (Drive > UX > Forms). For quick payouts we use prepaid cards; for panels >$2k we do vendor invoices. Loop Legal for external messaging.

nina: welcome! For product context, PMs keep a short "Context: feature history" page in Notion under each PRD. If you need immediate context I can paste the last two sprint notes here.

ton i: thanks all. I clicked the Figma link and it says `You need permission to view this file`. Notion still 403.

it-bot: :key: IT ticket created: IT-7901 for Notion group sync and SSO invite reissue for toni@redwood.com. ETA 4-6 hours.

maya: re: Figma manual add done  you should get a join link now. If you still see errors reply with the exact error text. Also sending starter DS walkthrough invite for 3pm.

felix: @toni if you want to shadow a moderated interview this week, we have slots Tue/Wed. Observers see the session in Drive > UX Recordings and we create a Notion note linked to the recording. I'll add you to #user-research.

legal: Hey @felix  legal here. We can usually review consent copy within 48 hours for standard templates. If you change retention or export audio/video, flag that in the review. Put the doc in Notion > Legal > Reviews and tag @legal.

toni: Got the Figma invite, can see the DS file  thanks @maya! Notion still 403 but IT ticket noted. Please add me to #user-research, @felix, and I'll take a 3pm walkthrough.

maya: added you to #product-design and to the DS walkthrough calendar invite. Welcome aboard again and ping here for anything else.

felix: invited to #user-research and added you as observer to Tue 11am session. I'll DM the Drive link for templates.

ton i: Appreciate the quick help  will ping if Notion isn't cleared by EOD. Looking forward to the walkthrough and the research shadow.
